title: Minsk capture Premier League title
description: Grodno - Minsk 81-90 Minsk captured Premier League title. They outscored Grodno on the road in Game 4 of the Finals to lift the trophy. Grodno trailed by 15 points after 3 quarters before a 27-21 run in the last quarter cut the deficit to 81-90 at the end of the game. Minsk looked well-organized offensively handing out 29 assists. 24 personal fouls committed by Grodno helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. Worth to mention a great performance of forward Jovan Sljivancanin (196-1999, college: Carroll, MT) who helped to win the game recording 17 points, 9 rebounds and 5 assists. The former international center Vadzim Stubeda (206-2000, agency: Tolakh Tsimur) contributed with 18 points and 8 rebounds for the winners.
